observations.content: Task context: resolving an upstream sync merge conflict in a release fork of Dittobyte/Recompia; sync script tools/fork/sync-upstream.sh flagged it for manual resolution (exit 2 = conflict, 3 = guard failed). Assistant intends to merge locally, inspect, and ask user before committing/pushing.

Fork design (FORK.md): packages built from scratch (Windows third-party tools via game-build/scripts/fetch-windows-tools.ps1 with pinned SHA-256s, no base release zip), attested via actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8, releases created as drafts and immutable, launcher updates from fork (launcher/src-tauri/src/releases.rs REPO) and verifies attestation (update.rs verify_origin, attest.rs verify_release). CHANGELOG.md kept identical to upstream. v0.15.3 tag already used by fork's first build so upstream v0.15.3 is skipped.

tools/fork/check-guards.sh <commit> <fork> fails if release.yml mentions dittobyte|featurejosh|BASE_RELEASE|BASE_REPO, uses gh release download from repos other than libsdl-org/SDL or facebook/zstd, lacks fetch-windows-tools.ps1, uses -Base/$Base in make-release.ps1 or release.yml, lacks 'gh release create ... --draft', or lacks the ATTEST_PIN. Manual resolution procedure: merge, run check-guards.sh HEAD <fork>, push.

Fork main HEAD was 22a9c052 (Merge upstream main 3731dda6); fork commits include e429675a (build Windows from scratch, attest), d69c0251 (launcher attested releases), 926f7017, fac57a60. Upstream v0.16.0 tag commit is 714c28c3 (Release 0.16.0 build T: Tapir); upstream/main is 3ba16407, 106 commits ahead of fork HEAD (mostly co-op features).

Decided order: merge v0.16.0 commit 714c28c3 first (message 'Merge upstream v0.16.0') so the sync releases v0.16.0 from that merge, then merge upstream/main. The v0.16.0 merge is in progress with conflicts in .github/workflows/release.yml, game-build/scripts/make-release.ps1, launcher/src-tauri/Cargo.lock.

Upstream v0.16.0 changes causing conflicts: launcher renamed to Recompia (recompia.exe, plus stub recompia-stub.exe from launcher/stub as PokopiaLauncher.exe); make-release.ps1 gains -Stub param, Readme function with @LAUNCHER@, Same/Zip functions, and produces two zips: Recompia-<v>-windows-x64.zip and old-name PokopiaRecomp-<v>-win64.zip (full launcher as PokopiaLauncher.exe, no starter, shipped for three releases). Upstream release.yml still uses gh release download BASE_RELEASE/-Base, adds 'Check the packages' step, win-launcher artifact path work/win-launcher, launcher paths build/launcher/recompia.exe and recompia-stub.exe. Resolution must keep fork's -Tools/no-base approach, astcdec/fonts/kbm_icons, attestation comments, while adopting rename, stub and two-zip logic.
